summary: DebOps is a collection of general-purpose Ansible roles designed to configure and maintain Debian or Ubuntu server environments. It functions as an automation toolkit to manage multiple hosts and services from a central control machine without requiring a custom agent on each node.
goodFor: Sysadmins and engineers who prefer a modular, playbook-driven approach to standardising infrastructure across Debian and Ubuntu deployments.
watchOut: Relying on a large collection of third-party Ansible roles can introduce debugging overhead when upstream updates break existing configurations or playbooks.
deployNotes: You will need a local control machine with Python and Ansible installed to execute the playbooks against your target hosts over SSH.
